task_records.description: Extend the existing scenario fixture in `tests/consumer-fixtures/workflow-improvements/implementation-scope-cases.json` with stable scenario IDs, requirement IDs, valid-control references, one-mutation negative cases, and expected production outcomes for Feature 023; keep it as scenario input data and do not encode routing or guard decisions in the fixture.

[P] [US1] Add controller definition tests in `tests/test_controller.py` for misplaced `cases.default`, malformed root/node/case/default containers, supported empty branches, and unknown, self, forward, cross-branch, and post-join-infeasible producer references; assert stable lowercase hyphenated `reason_code` values, exact node IDs, and root `location: workflow` or `steps` with an explicit null `step_id`, as required by `data-model.md` and `contracts/validation-boundaries.md`; exclude raw input values, rendered prompts, and host paths.

[P] [US1] Add source inventory and graph tests in `tests/test_workflow_graph.py` and `tests/test_workflow_paths.py` proving every owned package is validated, valid earlier-producer references do not require pre-production outputs, and the deprecated Start Feature remains stop-only.

[US1] Add catalog boundary tests in `tests/test_catalog.py` that attempt invalid source build, development snapshot, verification, and install/refresh from disposable inputs, assert rejection before package or consumer writes, and compare consumer before/after inventories.

[US1] Extend `validate_workflow_definition()` and its graph/template helpers in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/controller.py` to validate malformed branch structures, reserve `default` as a sibling of `cases`, accept supported empty lists, and prove producer order and route feasibility with bounded prior-producer propagation; retain the existing `ValueError` failure contract and loop-condition/carrier rules.

[US1] Project contextual definition diagnostics from `tools/validate_workflows.py` and validate source definitions before catalog packaging, release verification, development-snapshot approval, and delivery effects in `tools/catalog.py`; preserve existing ownership and installation checks.

[P] [US2] Extend `tests/test_implement_switch_routing.py` with production-route cases for both preparation/source skips, empty cases, empty top-level defaults, unknown choices without a fallback, and zero execution of untaken branch children.

[P] [US2] Extend `tests/test_workflow_paths.py` and `tests/test_controller.py` with runtime rendering cases proving earlier producer references pass definition validation before production, are resolved only when consumed, and reject missing, invalid, or stale prior-pass outputs before affected effects.

[US2] Update selected-route traversal and runtime preflight in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/controller.py` to render switch expressions/applicable metadata, select through `select_switch_branch()`, and render selected children only at consumption; preserve `render_template(value, inputs, outputs)`, current-output validation, and existing successor/guard behavior.

[US2] Update the rendering and selected-child boundaries in `controllers/farmboy/controller-protocol.md` and `workflows/README.md` so the manual-prompt route observes the same selected-only rendering and safe-stop behavior as native dispatch.

[P] [US3] Add connected positive expectations in `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` and scenario records in `tests/consumer-fixtures/workflow-improvements/implementation-scope-cases.json` for task resolution followed by marker-only tracking and for genuine reviewed source correction; assert historical scope/assessment/preimage digests remain unchanged while current evidence is rechecked.

[P] [US3] Add attributable negative controls in `tests/test_implementation_progress.py` and `tests/test_controller.py` for forged, altered, missing, or unbound historical proof; stale current review; unauthorized task edits; missing or wrong-branch required outputs; no substantive progress; and each existing exhausted budget. Add otherwise-valid administrative-only, answer-only, marker-only, and fresh-child-session variants and assert none creates substantive resolution, reconstructs historical proof, or resets existing counters/budgets; retain same-child answer relay and independently reviewed genuine-progress controls. Each case must establish a valid control, mutate one guard, and assert the expected reason/action with no subsequent source dispatch.

[US3] Extend `tests/test_phase_lifecycle.py` with regression assertions for applied roadmap-preimage readback: preserve receipt/effect identity and mutation count without invoking the writer again, and continue rejecting a separately changed non-roadmap artifact.

[US3] Extend `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to execute the two connected positive traces using production rendering, branch selection, activation/history, task tracking, actual post-pass capture, and guarded progress/route helpers; use the existing exact `post-pass-capture` request fields `scope`, `trusted_request_reference`, `retained_scope_sha256`, `entry_history_sha256`, `task_tracking_successors`, `producer_pairs`, `eligibility_request`, `completion_branch`; record selected and prevented steps and counters without copying controller decisions into the harness. Assert successful traces produce zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects.

[US3] Extend `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to run each negative mutation from its valid control and capture the production blocker/action, zero later dispatch, unchanged retained records, and unchanged counters; cover assignment, unresolved gate, same-child answer relay, installation-drift stops, and the administrative-only, answer-only, marker-only, and fresh-child-session non-credit variants without fallback. Assert none reconstructs historical proof or resets budgets, and blocked traces produce zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects.

[US4] Extend `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` with paired source/installed assertions for valid skips and empty/default routes, malformed definition rejection, producer timing, both positive connected traces, all FR-009 negative guards, and matching selected/prevented steps, blockers, current-evidence decisions, and counters. Include lifecycle receipt-readback parity and successful/blocked trace assertions for zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects; the disposable lifecycle execution is added in T018.

[US4] Add portable-observation contract tests in `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` for component IDs/versions/raw digests, repository-relative coordinates, tested CLI/runtime, installed inventory, scenario and requirement IDs, execution mode, expected/observed results, effects/dispatch, valid control, and parity; reject absolute paths, personal identifiers, secrets, and raw transcripts.

[US4] Extend the supported disposable development-snapshot setup in `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` and `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` to load the same scenario descriptions against source and installed controller modules and workflow bytes; include a disposable applied-roadmap receipt readback/reassessment through the installed production lifecycle module as well as source, without mutating Feature 023's real roadmap. Assert no second writer invocation and unchanged receipt identity, timestamp, digest, and mutation count, then reject a separately changed non-roadmap artifact; use the existing catalog installer and initialized-consumer prerequisites, and fail when any required integration prerequisite is missing instead of counting a skip as parity. Preserve commit `54b394e` as a regression baseline rather than reimplementing its fix.

[US4] Extend the feature-local observation writer in `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to record actual provenance, expected/observed outcomes, effects, retained before/after hashes, counters, valid-control/mutation references, and source/installed parity; include lifecycle effect and receipt identity, timestamp/digest, mutation count, retained receipt/preimage, and non-roadmap current-hash rejection observations. Enforce `Repository-relative coordinates only, with no host paths, personal identifiers, secrets or raw transcripts.` Label deterministic Reviewer/Tasker outcomes as deterministic; they cannot establish native agent identity/settings, publication, stock compatibility, adoption or acceptance.

[P] Document definition/runtime boundaries, diagnostic interpretation, selected-route input timing, safe next actions, and deterministic evidence limits in `docs/installation.md` and `tests/consumer-fixtures/README.md`.

Run the focused source and disposable-consumer commands in `specs/023-workflow-branch-validation-controller-integration/quickstart.md`, record actual CLI/runtime and component/source digests in feature-local `specs/023-workflow-branch-validation-controller-integration/validation/`, and report any unavailable prerequisite or failed parity scenario without claiming broader compatibility or acceptance.

criteria.source_item: No implementation details prescribing languages, frameworks, storage layout, or harness architecture.
Focused on user value and business needs.
Written for maintainer/operator stakeholders of this technical workflow product.
Success criteria describe outcomes rather than implementation details.
All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria.
Requirements support measurable Success Criteria outcomes.
No implementation mechanics leak into the specification.

facts: Exact immutable pass27 checkpoint retained except authorized budget40 binding and corresponding eligibility binding plus operator recovery authority.
Original scope of 21 tasks, all 18 current proofs and QA27 original activation anchors, 14 tracking witnesses, prior envelope and baseline preserved.
History remains 81 events with 27 sessions and attempts consumed; cumulative receipt anchors original five, human authority states effective 30 to 40.
No broad tests repeated. Prior QA27 evidence remains authoritative for its recorded test results and three T019 defects.
Review writes only its two reports; staged index, roadmap, receipts, history and task state unchanged.

preserved_protocol_gaps.observed: T005 ready activation declares controller.py only; supporting tests/test_controller.py changed under T005 QA without its own per-task activation. Global Coder ownership included that file for T008, but global ownership does not establish T005 per-task activation. Independently anchored original test preimage and actual source delta are retained; no receipt/hash has been rewritten.
preserved_protocol_gaps.safe_action: Main must record precise protocol exception and ensure future per-task activation includes supporting test paths before effect. This reviewer does not grant retroactive activation or expand source scope.

preserved_evidence_limits: Original pass6 supporting-test activation gap remains recorded, without retroactive reconstruction.
Existing no-progress stop remains historical evidence; this report does not resolve any T019 defect.
inference: The three recorded corrections belong to existing T019 and require fresh activation and independent review through this retained authorized Implement run.

findings.exact_correction: Within existing T019 collect all components actually used from reviewed source and installer records; retain each actual ID/version, raw source and installed payload digests and repository-relative coordinates, source commit/dirty state, actual runtime and complete relevant installed inventory. Prove omitted, changed or mislabeled component evidence fails actual-writer validation. Do not alter installed or production source packages.
findings.observed_deficiency: Both fresh environments emit only farmboy-controllers, farmboy-implement and flow-roadmap. The actual catalog installer uses the farmboy bundle and agent package and required wiki; the guard execution also reads installed farmboy-closeout bytes. Those identities and coordinates are absent. Controller source_sha256 hashes only the manifest; roadmap source_sha256 hashes installed inventory rather than raw source payload and has no separate installed digest/source coordinate. The installed inventory excludes bundle/agent/closeout/wiki payloads.
findings.violated_requirement: T019 actual provenance; connected-observations.md requires own ID/version/source digest and installed bytes for every actual component used, including bundle, workflows, controller, agents and required extensions.

findings.exact_correction: Within existing T019 project actual production packets without unknown-state coercion or expectation fallback from observed results. Preserve successful valid controls distinctly from each real one-mutation rejection, retaining actual blocker/action and control references; record real dispatch/effect events and counts and original baseline/assessment/preimage before/after/current-evidence references. Project actual lifecycle state, writer/receipt/preimage hashes and unchanged counters. Add focused checks comparing writer output to execution packets, including the accepted relay/assignment/bootstrap/gate controls and their real mutations.
findings.observed_deficiency: Fresh execution has production_state accepted for same-child relay, assignment and bootstrap controls, but emitted observed.decision is blocked and expected.decision is derived from that coerced observation. Assignment/bootstrap mutation_state and mutation_blocker and gate valid-choice/invalid-choice records are discarded, leaving mutation null and fabricated blocked control labels. Every negative dispatch_count is 1 merely because a zero-later-dispatch summary is inserted into dispatches. SI012 production blocker loop-cap-exhausted becomes production-route-observed. Positive records use connected-production-observation, omit actual action and baseline/current-evidence bindings, set retained_history_sha256 null, and count history/capture administration as source effects. Lifecycle verified state and decision are hardcoded continue rather than projected production states.
findings.violated_requirement: T019 faithful expected/observed outcomes, effects/dispatch, retained before/after hashes, counters, valid control/mutation and lifecycle results; connected-observations.md requires actual reason/action and separately valid controls.

findings.exact_correction: Within existing T019 bind generic writer validation to independently collected actual provenance and executed scenario packets, compare normalized source/installed outcomes before assigning parity, and reject mismatches rather than claiming match. Reject all absolute host paths and portable private/secret/transcript content. Add valid-control single-field checks against actual emitted records for each confirmed forgery, missing hash and path leak while preserving T017 fixture labels and coverage.
findings.observed_deficiency: Each scenario parity match is copied from four controller/workflow byte comparisons without comparing paired scenario decisions, blockers/actions, selected/prevented steps, effects, counters or lifecycle outcomes. Independent valid-control single-field mutations were accepted in both environments: false component digest, false tested CLI, false counter, empty parity components labeled match, absent retained hashes, and an absolute /opt host path. The validator checks hash syntax and an allowlisted path regex, not evidence binding or all absolute paths. No focused tests exercise actual writer validation; T017 remains an honestly synthetic contract fixture.
findings.violated_requirement: T019 source/installed outcome parity and enforcement of portable trustworthy observations; FR-015 absolute host-path exclusion and connected-observations.md discrepancies fail parity.

safe_resumption_action: Main controller may resume only the operator-authorized retained T019 correction through existing Implement gates; revalidate immediately before effects, record activation, preserve history and all retained bindings, and retain the 40 ceiling.

environment_validation.prepare: Auto-review rejected potentially mutating preparation; existing environment passed read-only check; no environment changes.
